title: LocalSend: Free AirDrop Alternative for All Platforms (No Internet Needed)
description:
LocalSend is a free open-source app that lets you send files between Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, and iOS devices over your local WiFi – no internet, no accounts, no cloud. Simple, secure, cross-platform.
